header: ORDER SHEET
IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
CIRCUIT COURT MIRPURKHAS
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
1. For order on M.A No.3836 of 2026.
2. For order on office objection.
3. For order on M.A No.3839 of 2026.
4. For hearing of main case.
Mr. Kanji Mal Meghwar advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G.
1. Urgency granted.
2. Office objection be complied with within 07 days.
3. Exemption is granted subject to all just exceptions.
4. Through this Petition, the petitioner is seeking direction to
the respondents in respect of Foti Khata Badal. Learned Additional
A.G, present in Court in other matters, waived notice of instant
petition and submits that now Government of Sindh has
constituted District Redressal Committee in each District wherein
the Deputy Commissioner of the District is Chairman of said
Committee. Learned A.A.G further submits that upon approaching
body: the concerned Deputy Commissioner/Chairman of the District Redressal Committee, the petitioner's grievance shall be entertained.

In view of above, instant Petition is disposed of with direction to the petitioner to approach Deputy Commissioner/Chairman District Redressal Committee concerned within a week by filing such application and same shall be decided within 30 days in accordance with law after hearing all concerned. Copy of this order be communicated to learned Additional A.G and the Deputy Commissioner/Chairman District Redressal Committee concerned for compliance.
